title: Authorize exact P04 compatibility baseline rebind
goal: Place a single-use trusted-base record for the 1.2.2 plugin hash rebind required by the P04 repair.
acceptanceCriteria: Only this Plan pair and its single-use authorization record change in the authorization PR.
The record binds the current base and reviewed candidate SHA-256 bytes of the compatibility baseline.
The base-owned Contract classifies this PR as authorization-added and required checks pass.
risks: A wrong candidate hash would fail closed and require a new authorization record.
decisions: Authorize only the exact compatibility baseline rebind for plugin.json version 1.2.2.
The authorization PR does not change protected files or publish a release.
